Title: Ambition
Logline: A man wakes in his office at 23:47 and cannot remember the hour he lost.
HourglassBeat: An hourglass in the boardroom is nearly empty, and still only atmospheric.

CrossChapterRefs.Note: Adrian discovers the coin under the blotter. Every later chapter meets the same object.
The boardroom hourglass is borrowed time, still only atmospheric.
Maya, the student in the lobby, is the protagonist of Chapter 02.
Elena Moretti's waiver is already in the desk.
Daniel Cross's evening column is in the boardroom.
Clara's unfinished canvas already contains the coin.
You don't have much time. You shouldn't open that door.

Locations.Name: Vale Tower — office
Locations.Description: A corner office above a rain-soaked city. The carpet remembers someone's knees.

Locations.Name: East corridor
Locations.Description: A narrow corridor. Wet footprints point both ways and agree on nothing.

Locations.Name: Boardroom
Locations.Description: A glass room set for an announcement nobody stayed to make.

Locations.Name: Roof landing
Locations.Description: The last door on the floor. Rain has opinions about the seam.

Locations.Name: Lobby, 23:15
Locations.Description: The tower lobby, earlier than the office. The rain is inside the light.

Cards.Title: THE AWAKENING
Cards.Body: The carpet is wet at the knees. The office has kept the rain out and the hour in. A clock on the shelf is not blinking. It is simply stopped.

Cards.Title: THE ROOM
Cards.Body: The room knows his name better than he does. Glass, a desk, a photograph that has lost a face.

Cards.Title: THE DESK
Cards.Body: Papers for a night that was supposed to end in a signature. Some of them have already been handled. Some of them have not.

Cards.Title: THE COIN
Cards.Body: Something small has been waiting under the blotter. It is not a key. He is the one who finds it.

Cards.Title: THE MESSAGE
Cards.Body: The phone has one message and the patience of a machine. The voice is young. The time is 23:12.

Cards.Title: THE CORRIDOR
Cards.Body: The corridor is narrower than the decision that filled it. Water has been walked in and not walked back.

Cards.Title: THE FLASHBACK
Cards.Body: Colour leaves, then a little of it returns. The lobby is earlier than this room. She is still there.

Cards.Title: THE BRANCH
Cards.Body: 23:15 can be visited. What he does with her papers will still be on the desk when the hour is late.

Cards.Title: THE STRANGER
Cards.Body: A man with no face stands where the light fails. He speaks like a threat. He speaks like a warning.

Cards.Title: THE HOURGLASS
Cards.Body: The boardroom is set for no one. The sand in the glass has almost finished agreeing with the clock.

Cards.Title: THE DOOR
Cards.Body: He was told not to open it. The bar is cold. The rain is on the other side, and so is whatever he wants.

Cards.Title: THE HOUR
Cards.Body: The clock moves once, to 23:55. The office keeps what the hour made of him.

Variants.Body: The contract is stamped DELAYED. A student card lies in the ink. The roof door is still shut. The clock says 23:55, and the memo has nowhere to put his name.
The contract is stamped DELAYED. The roof door has been opened onto the rain. A wet print crosses the memo. The clock says 23:55.
The contract is stamped EXECUTED, 23:16. The phone holds a sentence that ends in blank paper. The roof door is shut. The clock says 23:55.
The contract is stamped EXECUTED, 23:16. The roof door stands open. One shoe is on the landing. The clock says 23:55, and the second glass was never filled.

Clues.Title: Stopped clock
Clues.Description: The shelf clock reads 23:47. The second hand is not trying. Rain ticks louder than it does.

Clues.Title: Photograph without a face
Clues.Description: A framed photograph on the north wall. The room, the suit, the rain in the glass are still there. The face has been eaten down to a pale blank.

Clues.Title: Nameplate
Clues.Description: ADRIAN VALE. CHIEF EXECUTIVE. The letters are clean. A second line under the title has been scraped until the metal shows.

Clues.Title: Rain on the glass
Clues.Description: The city is a black strip under the window. A few signs keep a little colour. The rest of the night has given it up.

Clues.Title: Northline contract
Clues.Description: A consolidation agreement for Northline Transit. The signature line is still open. A time has been pencilled in the margin: before midnight.

Clues.Title: Waiver
Clues.Description: A medical waiver clipped behind the contract. Dr. Elena Moretti advises the patient named on the first line against strain after dusk. The second name has been scraped away.

Clues.Title: Torn card
Clues.Description: A story card torn through the title. The visible print reads CARD 0 and then nothing. The rest of the line is a blank bite.

Clues.Title: Plaque with no name
Clues.Description: A small plaque by the door. The screw holes are there. The name is not. Someone took the time to lift the letters and not replace them.

Clues.Title: The coin
Clues.Description: A coin under the blotter. One face is blank. The other is worn into the shape of an hourglass. Nobody put it in his hand. He found it.

Clues.Title: Voicemail, 23:12
Clues.Description: Maya's voice, careful, out of breath. She is in the lobby. She says the papers have to be signed before midnight or the page goes blank.

Clues.Title: Second voice
Clues.Description: Under the last three seconds of the voicemail, rain, and a second voice, too low to belong to Maya. It says she does not have much time. It does not say what to do.

Clues.Title: Wet coat
Clues.Description: The coat on the chair is still wet at the shoulders. A lobby receipt in the pocket is timed 23:00.

Clues.Title: Umbrella
Clues.Description: A student umbrella, still open enough to drip. The water points back toward the elevator, not toward the office.

Clues.Title: Witness statement
Clues.Description: The pages are a witness statement about Northline's night routes. Maya says they have to be signed before midnight or the text disappears. She did not write them.

Clues.Title: The warning in the lobby
Clues.Description: Maya says a silhouette told her she did not have much time, and that she should not trust the quiet. She did not see a face. She still needed a signature.

Clues.Title: The hourglass
Clues.Description: An hourglass on the boardroom table, sand almost gone. No meeting is using it. It is simply running out.

Clues.Title: Evening paper
Clues.Description: The evening paper, folded to a column by Daniel Cross. The piece is about a man who missed the last train. One name in the second paragraph is a black bar.

Clues.Title: Unfinished canvas
Clues.Description: A canvas leans on the boardroom wall. Rain, a tower, a small coin in the corner that the paint has not finished. On the back, a name: Clara. The date is scratched out.

Clues.Title: Cold bar
Clues.Description: The roof-door bar is cold. Rain presses the seam from the other side. Nothing on the door says what the landing is for.

Clues.Title: One shoe
Clues.Description: One black shoe on the wet landing. The railing bolt beside it is sheared. The rain has been coming in longer than the shoe has been here.

Clues.Title: Untouched bar
Clues.Description: The bar is still latched. A dry oval on the metal shows where a hand almost settled and then did not.

Clues.Title: Delayed stamp
Clues.Description: The contract is stamped DELAYED. A student card lies in the ink, Maya's, still warm. The memo under it has a blank where a name should be printed in the morning.

Clues.Title: Delayed, and the door
Clues.Description: The contract is stamped DELAYED. A wet print crosses the memo from the direction of the roof door. The student card is in the ink. The landing was still visited.

Clues.Title: Executed stamp
Clues.Description: The contract is stamped EXECUTED, 23:16. The phone shows a message that ends mid-word. The rest of the line is blank paper. The roof door is shut.

Clues.Title: Executed, and the landing
Clues.Description: The contract is stamped EXECUTED, 23:16. The second glass on the desk was never filled. The roof door was opened. The phone's last sentence stops in a blank.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_MAYA
Dialogue.Text: A voicemail, 23:12. A young woman's voice, careful, out of breath. "Mr. Vale, it's Maya. I'm in the lobby. If the papers aren't signed by midnight they said the page goes blank. Please."

Choices.Text: Play the last three seconds again.
Save the message and put the phone down.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_MAYA
Dialogue.Text: The last three seconds are mostly rain. Under it, a second voice, almost kind, tells her she does not have much time.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_ADRIAN
Dialogue.Text: He saves it. The phone goes dark. The lobby does not.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_MAYA
Dialogue.Text: Mr. Vale? I need you to sign this before midnight. They said the papers vanish at twelve. I came straight up. I wasn't sure you'd still be here.

Choices.Text: The deal is tonight. Take them back down.
Who told you that you don't have much time?

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_MAYA
Dialogue.Text: I didn't see a face. He stood where the light stops. He said I didn't have much time, and that I shouldn't trust the quiet. Will you sign them?

Choices.Text: The deal is tonight. Take them back down.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_MAYA
Dialogue.Text: Then here. Before the ink decides to leave. I'll wait while you read. I can wait.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_MAYA
Dialogue.Text: Then I'll take them back down. I hope the lobby still has a door.

Choices.Text: Then tell me how I died.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_STRANGER
Dialogue.Text: If a warning frightens you, keep it.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_STRANGER
Dialogue.Text: That is the wrong question. You already walked past the answer.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_STRANGER
Dialogue.Text: You shouldn't open that door. You will know it by how badly you want it open.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_STRANGER
Dialogue.Text: You found it. Don't ask me what it wants.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_ADRIAN
Dialogue.Text: The roof door. The bar is cold. Rain pushes at the seam.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_ADRIAN
Dialogue.Text: The latch gives. Rain comes in and does not explain itself.

Dialogue.Speaker: CH_ADRIAN
Dialogue.Text: He takes his hand off the bar. The dry mark of it stays.

Memories.QuestionAnswered: At 23:15 Maya was in the lobby with a witness statement about Northline, and she needed a signature before midnight.
Memories.QuestionOpened: A silhouette told her she did not have much time. The statement does not say what happens if the door upstairs is opened.
Memories.HoldLine: The memory is still holding something.

Interactables.Title: Clock
Interactables.InspectText: 23:47. The second hand has stopped mid-accusation.

Interactables.Title: Photograph
Interactables.InspectText: The face is gone. The suit is still standing in the rain.

Interactables.Title: Nameplate
Interactables.InspectText: ADRIAN VALE. CHIEF EXECUTIVE. The line under it has been scraped clean.

Interactables.Title: Window
Interactables.InspectText: Rain on the glass. The city keeps a little colour and no explanations.

Interactables.Title: Contract
Interactables.InspectText: Northline Transit. The signature line is open. Midnight is written in the margin like a dare.

Interactables.Title: Waiver
Interactables.InspectText: Elena Moretti's waiver. Strain after dusk. A second name, removed.

Interactables.Title: Torn card
Interactables.InspectText: CARD 0 — and then a tear where the title should be.

Interactables.Title: Plaque
Interactables.InspectText: The letters were lifted out. The name did not grow back.

Interactables.Title: Coin
Interactables.InspectText: Blank on one face. An hourglass worn into the other. He is the one who finds it.

Interactables.Title: Phone
Interactables.InspectText: One message. 23:12.

Interactables.Title: Coat
Interactables.InspectText: Wet at the shoulders. A lobby receipt timed 23:00.

Interactables.Title: Umbrella
Interactables.InspectText: Maya's umbrella, still dripping toward the elevator.

Interactables.Title: Stranger
Interactables.InspectText: A silhouette. No face to inspect.

Interactables.Title: Hourglass
Interactables.InspectText: Sand, almost finished. Nobody called a meeting.

Interactables.Title: Newspaper
Interactables.InspectText: Daniel Cross. A man who missed the last train. A name barred out in black.

Interactables.Title: Canvas
Interactables.InspectText: Rain, the tower, a coin not finished. Clara, on the back. The date is gone.

Interactables.Title: Roof door
Interactables.InspectText: Cold metal. Rain on the far side.

Interactables.Title: Shoe
Interactables.InspectText: One shoe. A sheared bolt. Rain older than the shoe.

Interactables.Title: Latch
Interactables.InspectText: Still latched. The dry oval of a hand that changed its mind.

Interactables.Title: Maya
Interactables.InspectText: A student with a wet coat and a folder she will not put down.

Interactables.Title: Statement
Interactables.InspectText: Northline's night routes. A signature line. Midnight.

Interactables.Title: Return
Interactables.InspectText: The memory can be left once it has given up the page.

Interactables.Title: Desk, delayed
Interactables.InspectText: DELAYED. A student card in the ink. A blank where the morning memo wants a name.

Interactables.Title: Desk, delayed
Interactables.InspectText: DELAYED. A wet print from the roof door crosses the memo.

Interactables.Title: Desk, executed
Interactables.InspectText: EXECUTED, 23:16. The phone's last sentence ends in blank paper.

Interactables.Title: Desk, executed
Interactables.InspectText: EXECUTED, 23:16. The second glass was never filled. The door was.
